requirements.text: Enrolled in Business Administration, Marketing or a similar degree program, ideally for at least another year.
Can work up to 20 hours per week.
Strong affinity for numbers and can turn data into actionable recommendations.
Takes ownership and independently drives topics forward.
Intrinsic motivation and a proactive mindset.
Hands-on experience in Performance Marketing, Paid Social or Marketing Analytics through an internship, working student role or personal projects.
Campaign analysis and optimization on platforms like Meta Ads or TikTok Ads.
Knowledge of additional languages (FR, ES, IT).
Create reports, evaluate campaign results and identify opportunities for improvement.
Use AI tools to manage and optimize campaigns instead of relying on traditional advertising interfaces.

resumes.text:
Mia Hartmann
Business Administration student, Mannheim, Germany

Summary
Business Administration student with two years of hands-on performance marketing work for small online shops. Available up to 20 hours per week during term. Fluent English and a genuine enjoyment of spreadsheets and sales figures.

Experience
Working Student, Pixelforge Digital, Mannheim (October 2024 to present, up to 15 hours per week)
- Run and optimise Google Ads search campaigns for six small e-commerce clients, reviewing keyword and budget performance every week.
- Built weekly reports on cost per acquisition and return on ad spend, and presented recommendations to account leads.
- Turned sales exports into concrete weekly recommendations that the client team acted on.
- Took full ownership of a client's seasonal account, from planning through to final reporting, without supervision.
- Used an AI assistant to set up ad groups and adjust weekly promotions for a home-goods client.

Intern, Rhein Logistik GmbH, Ludwigshafen (summer 2025, eight weeks, unpaid)
- Helped plan warehouse shifts and track delivery times in spreadsheets.

Personal Projects
- Started and kept a newsletter for local students on my own initiative, growing it to 800 readers.

Education
BSc Business Administration, University of Mannheim (2024 to expected 2028)

Skills
Google Ads, Google Analytics, Excel, data analysis, A/B testing basics, presentation.

Languages
English: fluent, written and spoken
German: native
Dutch: basic
